definitions.gloss: safety fence; protective barrier; guard rail
definitions.explanation: A fence or railing put up to keep people away from something dangerous — machinery, a construction site, a platform edge, or a drop. Common on signage and in workplace safety rules.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事現場|こうじげんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{安全柵|あんぜんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}した→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧。
examples.english: A safety fence was installed at the construction site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{安全柵|あんぜんさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A safety barrier is required around the machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちない→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{安全柵|あんぜんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}けた→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧。
examples.english: We fitted a safety gate at the top of the stairs so the child would not fall.

examples.japanese: {安全柵|あんぜんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧⟦{線路|せんろ}→線路：04041_senro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧だ。
examples.english: Climbing over the safety barrier onto the tracks is an extremely dangerous act.

notes:
⟦{柵|さく}→柵：13103_saku⟧ is a fence of posts and rails, so the compound names the barrier by its purpose rather than its material.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安全柵|あんぜんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install a safety fence
- {安全柵|あんぜんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧: to climb over a safety barrier
- {安全柵|あんぜんさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内側|うちがわ}→内側：05449_uchigawa⟧: inside the barrier

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦フェンス→フェンス：26996_fensu⟧: fence — the general loanword, without the safety purpose
- ⟦ガードレール→ガードレール：06517_gaadoreeru⟧: guardrail — specifically the metal barrier along a road
- ⟦{手|て}すり→手すり：12754_tesuri⟧: handrail — for holding on to, not for keeping people out
